info.description: Zero-knowledge secret manager API. Stores and retrieves ciphertext. Never decrypts.
info.title: zEnv API

get.description: Query audit log entries with filters. Requires project_id.

post.description: Force-flush all queued audit events from Redis to Postgres.

get.description: Export filtered audit log entries as a CSV file.

put.description: Rotate the Vault Key. The client derives the old KEK, unwraps the DEK, derives a new KEK from the new Vault Key, re-wraps the same DEK, and submits the new crypto material. This is an O(1) operation — zero vault item rows are touched. Requires the current Vault Key to be verified before rotation is applied.

parameters.description: Current auth proof and new crypto material
parameters.name: body

400.description: Missing required fields, invalid vault_key_type, or malformed base64

post.description: Clears the vault unlock record in Redis, requiring the user to re-enter their Vault Key on next access. Safe to call even if already locked.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's identity info, vault setup status, and vault lock state. Use this to determine whether to show the vault setup flow, the unlock prompt, or the main UI. The salt is returned so the client can derive the KEK locally without an extra round trip.
Returns which recovery methods are available for this user.

post.description: Store client-generated cryptographic material and link to the authenticated identity. Must be called once after signup before any vault operations. All crypto material is generated client-side — the server stores ciphertext only. On success, the session is immediately marked as vault-unlocked.

400.description: Missing required fields, invalid vault_key_type, or malformed base64

409.description: Vault already set up for this account

post.description: Verify the Auth Key hash (proof of Vault Key knowledge). On success, marks the session as vault-unlocked in Redis and returns the wrapped DEK and keypair so the client can derive the KEK and unwrap locally. The raw Vault Key never leaves the client.

parameters.description: Auth Key hash derived from the user's Vault Key
parameters.name: body

400.description: Invalid request body or malformed base64

403.description: Wrong Vault Key — auth key hash mismatch

404.description: Vault not set up for this account

get.description: Returns the current user's preference JSON.

put.description: Shallow-merges the provided JSON into the current preferences.

get.description: List all projects in an organization.

post.description: Create a project with client-generated crypto material. Project Vault Key shown once at creation, never stored on server.

get.description: Get a single project by ID.

delete.description: Delete a project and all associated data (secrets, tokens, key grants).

get.description: Returns project salt and wrapped Project DEK. SDK uses this to derive Project KEK and unwrap DEK.

post.description: Upserts key grants for the specified users. Each grant contains the Project Vault Key wrapped with that user's public key.

get.description: Returns the current user's wrapped Project Vault Key for a project.
Returns all org members with vault keys and their grant status. Used during DEK rotation and access management.

post.description: Initiates a two-phase DEK rotation. Returns a rotation_id for staging and committing.

delete.description: Deletes staging rows and the rotation record. Only works for rotations in 'staging' or 'failed' state.

post.description: Atomically applies all staged ciphertexts, updates the wrapped DEK and key grants. All-or-nothing via Postgres transaction.

parameters.description: New wrapped DEK, salt, and key grants
parameters.name: body

post.description: Uploads a batch of re-encrypted ciphertexts to the staging table. Call repeatedly until all items are staged.

get.description: Get summary statistics for a project (secrets, tokens, audit logs).

post.description: Creates a project as the **service token creator** (Better Auth user resolved from the token's `created_by`). Inserts the project, initial `project_vault_keys` row, and a `project_key_grants` row for that user. Payload matches dashboard create: organization, display name, base64 project salt, wrapped project DEK, and wrapped project vault key for the creator.

parameters.description: organization_id, name, project_salt, wrapped_project_dek, wrapped_project_vault_key (all base64 where applicable)
parameters.name: body

409.description: Project name already exists in organization

get.description: Returns project salt and wrapped Project DEK. SDK uses this to derive Project KEK and unwrap DEK.

Returns the **token creator's** wrapped project vault key for the given project (`project_key_grants` row matching token `created_by` and path `projectID`). Used by CLIs and automation to unwrap the project vault key without a browser session. Not a generic lookup for arbitrary users.

404.description: No grant row for this creator and project

get.description: List secret rows for a project: name hash, environment, version, timestamps, and plaintext `metadata` (never ciphertext or nonces). Supports pagination, sorting, and filters by environment and version.

parameters.description: Sort field: updated_at | created_at | version | environment (default: updated_at)
parameters.name: sort_by

post.description: Store an encrypted vault item. The server stores opaque ciphertext and nonce only; the secret name is never sent in plaintext (HMAC-SHA256 name_hash). Optional `metadata` is plaintext JSON (mime_type, description, tags, labels) for operators and tooling — never put secret values in metadata.

400.description: Missing or invalid fields, or invalid base64 encoding

409.description: Secret with this name hash already exists in the given project+environment — use PUT to update

post.description: Fetch multiple encrypted secrets in one request by providing a list of HMAC-SHA256 name hashes. Used by clients for manifest loading. Each item in the response includes optional plaintext `metadata` alongside ciphertext. Missing hashes are omitted from the result (no error).

parameters.description: Project, environment, and list of name hashes to fetch
parameters.name: body

400.description: Invalid project_id or malformed base64 in name_hashes

get.description: Retrieve one encrypted secret by HMAC-SHA256 name hash (must match exactly). Returns ciphertext, nonce, version, timestamps, and optional plaintext metadata. Partial or plaintext name lookups are not supported.

400.description: Missing query params or invalid name hash encoding

put.description: Replace ciphertext and nonce for an existing secret; the prior row is archived and the version counter increments. Optional `metadata` in the body is shallow-merged with existing server-side metadata (same validation as PATCH metadata). Use GET /{nameHash}/versions for history.

parameters.description: New ciphertext, nonce, and optional metadata merge
parameters.name: body

delete.description: Permanently remove a secret and all its archived versions from the vault. This action is irreversible.

400.description: Missing params or invalid name hash

patch.description: Shallow-merge plaintext metadata for a vault item without changing ciphertext, nonce, or the secret version counter. Use this when only labels, MIME hints, or descriptions change. Body must be a JSON object; unknown keys return 400. Send JSON null for a key to remove it. Total metadata size is capped server-side.

400.description: Empty body, invalid JSON, unknown keys, or metadata limits exceeded

post.description: Revert a secret to a previously archived version. The current ciphertext is archived first, then the target version's ciphertext is restored. The version counter continues incrementing — it is never reset. Returns the updated secret after rollback.

400.description: Missing params, invalid name hash, or missing version in body

404.description: Secret not found, or target version not found in archive

get.description: Return the full version history for a secret. The current version is shown separately from the archived versions. Versions are ordered newest first.

400.description: Missing params or invalid name hash

post.description: Issues a new service token on behalf of the **authenticated token's creator** (the `created_by` user from the parent token). Same semantics as dashboard token create: plaintext returned once, stored as a hash. Requires a valid service token with `read_write` when routed through the SDK write group.

parameters.description: project_id, name, environment; optional permission (read|read_write, default read) and expires_at (RFC3339)
parameters.name: body

get.description: Returns the token creator's vault crypto material for client-side key derivation.
Returns the token name, human-readable creator (when available), project and organization names, environment, and permission for the **Bearer** service token used on this request.

get.description: List all tokens for a project. Never exposes token hash or plaintext.

parameters.description: Filter by status: active, revoked, all
parameters.name: status

post.description: Generate a scoped service token. Plaintext shown once, SHA-256 hashed before storage.

delete.description: Marks a service token as revoked. Immediate effect.
Permanently removes a service token from the database.

current_auth_key_hash.description: CurrentAuthKeyHash is HashAuthKey(currentVaultKey), used to verify the current Vault Key before rotation, base64-encoded.

new_salt.description: NewSalt is a freshly generated KDF salt for the new Key Encryption Key, base64-encoded.

new_vault_key_type.description: NewVaultKeyType is the type of the new Vault Key. Must be "pin" or "passphrase".

new_wrapped_dek.description: NewWrappedDEK is the same DEK re-wrapped with the new KEK, base64-encoded.

new_wrapped_private_key.description: NewWrappedPrivateKey is the private key re-wrapped with the new DEK, base64-encoded.

wrapped_project_dek.description: base64 — Project DEK wrapped with Project KEK

wrapped_project_vault_key.description: base64 — Project Vault Key wrapped with user's public key

metadata.description: Metadata is optional plaintext hints (MIME, description, tags). Never put secret material here.

email.description: Email is the user's email address from their identity provider.

name.description: Name is the user's display name from their identity provider.

salt.description: Salt is the KDF salt for the user's Key Encryption Key, base64-encoded. Only present if vault is set up.

vault_key_type.description: VaultKeyType is the type of Vault Key the user chose ("pin" or "passphrase"). Only present if vault is set up.

vault_setup_complete.description: VaultSetupComplete is true if the user has completed vault setup.

vault_unlocked.description: VaultUnlocked is true if the user has completed both auth layers in this session.

auth_key_hash.description: AuthKeyHash is base64(HashAuthKey(authKey)) — same proof stored at setup-vault (JSON field name is historical).

public_key.description: PublicKey is the user's raw Ed25519 public key, base64-encoded.

recovery_disabled.description: RecoveryDisabled disables all recovery methods for this account. Enterprise opt-in.

recovery_wrapped_dek.description: RecoveryWrappedDEK is the DEK wrapped with the recovery key, base64-encoded. Optional.

salt.description: Salt is the random salt used to derive the Key Encryption Key from the Vault Key, base64-encoded.

vault_key_type.description: VaultKeyType is the type of Vault Key the user chose. Must be "pin" or "passphrase".

wrapped_dek.description: WrappedDEK is the Data Encryption Key wrapped with the Key Encryption Key, base64-encoded.

wrapped_private_key.description: WrappedPrivateKey is the user's Ed25519 private key wrapped with the DEK, base64-encoded.

user_id.description: UserID is the newly created vault identity UUID.

vault_setup_complete.description: VaultSetupComplete is always true on success.

auth_key_hash.description:
AuthKeyHash must match setup-vault: base64(HashAuthKey(authKey)) where authKey is the
32-byte auth material from DeriveKeys (Argon2id output bytes 32–63). Same value as setup's auth_key_hash field.

public_key.description: PublicKey is the user's raw Ed25519 public key, base64-encoded.

wrapped_dek.description: WrappedDEK is the Data Encryption Key wrapped with the Key Encryption Key, base64-encoded.

wrapped_private_key.description: WrappedPrivateKey is the user's Ed25519 private key wrapped with the DEK, base64-encoded.
